title: ui: the `PackagedAutomationPage` test fixture still carries the old seven-sentence flow clone notice after #27886
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

Found by the #27886 card thread (PR #28072) and filed by the `domain:server` seat. Outside that PR's file surface (`ui/` is not server-lane). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong

PR #28072 rewrites `FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`) to one line: "The copy runs alongside the original until you switch one of them off, and it still uses the same subflows, actions and objects as the original."

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` keeps its own copy of the notice (`CLONE_NOTICE`, ~L100-101) with the old seven-sentence text. The tests stay green, because the stubbed door returns the fixture and the page renders it verbatim, but the fixture no longer matches what the server sends.

## Expected

The fixture carries the current notice text once #28072 merges, so the page tests read what the server sends. Test-only.

Blocked-by: #28072
